description: Mirrored pair: left root (1,0,0), end (6,0,0), pole (3.5,5,0); right root (-1,0,0), end (-6,0,0), pole (-3.5,5,0). Both limbs bend toward +Y at rest: left mid (2.8,2.4,0), right mid (-2.8,2.4,0). Every joint is at its rest. The derived controls (D57): left pole mid (2.8,2.4,0) + poleOffset (0.7,2.6,0) = (3.5,5,0), settings end (6,0,0) + settingsOffset (-5,8,0) = (1,8,0). The right is the reflection, X negated in the offsets on joints that are already reflected: pole (-3.5,5,0), settings (-1,8,0), and the handle on the end joint (-6,0,0).
